## What you will build

1. Implement Laplacian eigenmap and PCA on the adjacency matrix, and plot both.
2. Generate biased random walks with node2vec's p and q parameters.
3. Train a skip-gram model on those walks.
4. Factorize network matrices directly and compare with the neural embeddings.
5. Evaluate everything by link prediction.
6. Visualize higher-dimensional embeddings with t-SNE.

## What to watch for

- Sweep q from below 1 to above 1 and watch which nodes end up near each other. Low q should recover communities, high q should group nodes by role.
- Train the same model twice. The coordinates will differ completely while the link prediction score barely moves — embeddings are only defined up to rotation.
